name: @subhanhq/amicro
summary: React micro-interaction, transition and card/carousel components installed through the shadcn CLI.
description: A React component collection of micro-interactions, transitions, card layouts, carousels and spring presets powered by Motion (motion/react). Components, hooks and presets install through the shadcn CLI, either from a raw URL or via the @amicro namespace, copying TSX source into your project. Built for React 18/19 with Tailwind CSS v3/v4.
contains: 12 card layouts and carousels (arc, corner fan, coverflow, time machine stack)
install via shadcn CLI with the @amicro namespace or npx @subhanhq/amicro
hooks, spring presets and motion primitives
requires React 18/19, Tailwind CSS v3/v4 and Motion
